response.overview: A touching cultural documentary following poet "Ahmed Al-Obeidi" from the East and composer "Hanan Al-Rowaiei" from the West, as they unite to recall the history of Libyan social reconciliations during times of conflict. Together, they revive and craft an epic theatrical and poetic masterpiece centered around Libya's most famous historical peace accord, the "Harabi Covenant," using art and music to echo messages of peace, social harmony, and national unity.
response.tagline: How art and poetry stitched the fabric of a divided nation.
response.title: نغمة مصالحة - ليبيا
